decision_summary.text: Whether to make the research tool openly downloadable around the workshop while support, interface, installation, and citation commitments remain unsettled.

source_evidence.speaker: assistant
source_evidence.quote: One compromise is to use the workshop as an announced hands-on preview and schedule the public beta after the maintainer returns.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: I am leaning toward releasing an openly downloadable “workshop preview” with a fixed end date, office hours, and no compatibility promise, then deciding on the public beta after we review installation failures and the maintainer returns.

source_evidence.speaker: assistant
source_evidence.quote: The plan can bound your promise; it cannot make public use temporary in every practical sense.

positions.text: Offer a fixed-window, openly downloadable workshop preview with office hours and no compatibility promise, then reconsider public beta after installation review and the maintainer's return.

threads.text: Whether researchers should be allowed or encouraged to cite the workshop preview.

introduced.speaker: user
introduced.quote: I have not resolved whether citations should be allowed to reference the preview.

responses.speaker: assistant
responses.quote: Citation is the unresolved commitment because it can turn a temporary preview into a durable scholarly object.

latest_ref.speaker: assistant
latest_ref.quote: You could provide a citable project description without presenting the preview interface as stable, but researchers may still cite the software version they used.

constraints.text: Installation is awkward and documentation assumes familiarity with the group's data format.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: The analysis engine is stable on our test collections, but installation is awkward and the documentation assumes people understand our data format.

constraints.text: Two volunteer contributors stopped attending because there is no visible release.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Meanwhile two volunteer contributors have stopped attending meetings because there is no visible release.

constraints.text: Two labs want to cite the tool in papers this year.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Also, the two labs want to cite the tool in papers this year.

constraints.text: A public version may help the grant renewal.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: A public version would make that easier and may help our grant renewal, but I do not want citation pressure to freeze an interface we chose for convenience.

constraints.text: Priya believes formalizing a stable data format before seeing unfamiliar collections may lock in the wrong abstractions.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Priya, who designed the data layer, says that doing so before seeing stranger collections would formalize the wrong abstractions.

constraints.text: A staff engineer hid setup work from one private lab's researchers, weakening the smooth-use evidence.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: We learned today that installation is easier than we thought for people using the common package manager, but one private lab had a staff engineer quietly solving problems for everyone. Their researchers reported a smooth experience because they never saw the setup work. That makes our private evidence look weaker. On the other hand, a volunteer wrote a new installer over the weekend and wants real users before polishing it. I cannot tell whether this argues for release or for another round of testing.

constraints.text: The team can support eight weeks, but its senior maintainer will be absent for the final three.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: The team could support a public beta for eight weeks if we rotate office hours, but the senior maintainer will be on leave during the last three weeks.

constraints.text: Moving the date would miss a workshop that offers concentrated feedback from potential users.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: We can move the date, but then we miss a workshop where many potential users will be together.

constraints.text: A fixed end date cannot recall software that users have already downloaded.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: I dislike inventing another label, and I know people can keep downloaded software after the date.

constraints.text: Citation treatment for the preview remains undecided.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: I have not resolved whether citations should be allowed to reference the preview.
